lines.en: label kaoridate10:
I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点下手机里 Kaori 的名字，等她接起来。

lines.en: She normally works around this time, so I imagine that’s what she’s doing now- but I think I’d still like to see her regardless.
lines.zh: 这个时间她一般在上班，所以我想她现在大概正在做这件事——不过就算是这样，我还是想见她。

lines.en: In fact, I’m pretty positive that’s the case as I wouldn’t have selected her name without wanting that.
lines.zh: 其实我相当肯定就是这么回事，因为如果不是想见她，我也不会点下她的名字。

lines.en: But I digress.
lines.zh: 不过我扯远了。

lines.en: : Greetings, Friend! I am very glad you telephoned!
lines.zh: : 问候你，朋友！我很高兴你打电话过来！

lines.en: Oh, wow. An actual greeting this time.
lines.zh: 哦，哇。这次居然是真正的问候。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? And why is that?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？为什么这么说？

lines.en: : I require the large, muscley tubes you have attached to your human shoulders.
lines.zh: : 我需要你那对人类肩膀上接着的、又大又肌肉的管子。

lines.en: : They are called arms. And why?
lines.zh: : 那叫胳膊。还有，为什么？

lines.en: : I have been asked to go to a place and get things but I can’t get things since my shoulder-tubes are weak and not good at lifting multiple objects at once.
lines.zh: : 有人叫我去一个地方拿东西，可我拿不了，因为我的肩管很弱，不擅长一次举起好多件东西。

lines.en: : So I’m guessing you need help getting things from the store and bringing them back to your work?
lines.zh: : 所以，我猜你是需要人帮你把东西从店里拿出来、再搬回你上班的地方？

lines.en: : My description was better. But yes!
lines.zh: : 我的说法更好听。不过，对！

lines.en: : Please come. I will pay you in what humans call “high fives.”
lines.zh: : 请来吧。我会用人类所说的「击掌」付给你报酬。

lines.en: : Humans don’t usually pay each other in those but okay. It’s not like I had anything else to do.
lines.zh: : 人类一般不会用那个互相付账，不过好吧。反正我也没什么别的事。

lines.en: : That is great news!
lines.zh: : 这真是好消息！

lines.en: : Meet me at the store in twenty minutes!
lines.zh: : 二十分钟后，在店里见！

lines.en: Kaori hangs up the phone and I quickly find myself throwing on clothes before heading out the door.
lines.zh: Kaori 挂了电话，我很快就套上衣服出了门。

lines.en: scene black
: She never told me what store...
lines.zh: : 她根本没说是哪家店……

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience1
: I’m sorry again for never telling you where to meet me.
lines.zh: : 再次抱歉，我一直都没告诉你在哪儿碰头。

lines.en: : I would have answered you sooner but my phone was on moon-mode so the harsh light of the sun would not destroy it.
lines.zh: : 我本来会早点回你的，可我的手机开着月亮模式，这样太阳的强光就不会把它毁掉。

lines.en: : That moon icon is just the “Do not disturb” setting.
lines.zh: : 那个月亮图标只是「免打扰」设置而已。

lines.en: : That cannot be true as you were still able to disturb me.
lines.zh: : 这不可能，因为你还是成功打扰到我了。

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : And thank you for buying me this delicious sphere of cookie bread.
lines.zh: : 还有，谢谢你给我买了这个美味的曲奇面包球。

lines.en: : You haven’t even taken a bite yet.
lines.zh: : 你都还没咬一口呢。

lines.en: : I am absorbing the scent through my pointed dual face openings.
lines.zh: : 我正在用我脸上尖尖的两个洞吸收它的香气。

lines.en: : Nostrils. Or nose. Either one works. “Pointed dual face openings” is not an acceptable alternative.
lines.zh: : 那叫鼻孔。或者鼻子。两个都行。「脸上尖尖的两个洞」可不是可以接受的替代说法。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience2
: And also, thank you again for assisting me today.
lines.zh: : 还有，再次谢谢你今天来帮我。

lines.en: : I never would have imagined that the strange man who wandered into my store with his adorable [niece] would one day traverse the streets of the city with me.
lines.zh: : 我真没想到，那个带着可爱的 [niece] 走进我店里的奇怪男人，有一天会和我一起穿过这座城市的街道。

lines.en: : This would probably be a dream come true if I were able to dream.
lines.zh: : 如果我会做梦的话，这大概就是梦想成真了。

lines.en: : That wouldn’t exactly be an exciting dream.
lines.zh: : 那可算不上什么令人兴奋的梦。

lines.en: : Lies. I am filled with excitement. And also sugar as this is my third cookie bread.
lines.zh: : 谎话。我满心都是兴奋。还有糖分，因为这是我的第三个曲奇面包。

lines.en: : We’re only five feet outside of the store. How are you already on your third? That’s some Maya level speed.
lines.zh: : 我们才走出店门五英尺。你怎么已经吃到第三个了？这速度都赶上 Maya 了。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience3
: Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya？

lines.en: : What is a Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya 是什么？

lines.en: : Another small girl?
lines.zh: : 又一个小小的女孩？

lines.en: : Yeah. My [niece]’s friend. You’ve probably seen her around since you work in like eighty-seven restaurants.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我 [niece] 的朋友。你大概在附近见过她，毕竟你好像在八十七家餐厅打工。

lines.en: : What does she look like?
lines.zh: : 她长什么样？

lines.en: : Does she have hair? Eyes?
lines.zh: : 她有头发吗？有眼睛吗？

lines.en: : How many eyes?
lines.zh: : 有几只眼睛？

lines.en: : What? Two. And also yes, she has hair. Those are both normal things for humans to have.
lines.zh: : 什么？两只。还有，是的，她有头发。这两样对人类来说都是很正常的东西。

lines.en: : Then it is highly possible she has crossed my path. I have seen many girls with eyes.
lines.zh: : 那她极有可能和我打过照面。我见过很多有眼睛的女孩。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I stare at them for too long and they run away.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我盯着她们看太久，她们就跑掉了。

lines.en: : That’s a standard reaction to staring at girls.
lines.zh: : 盯着女孩看，人家这种反应很正常。

lines.en: : Do girls also run from you, Friend?
lines.zh: : 女孩也会从你身边跑开吗，朋友？

lines.en: : Surprisingly, not really.
lines.zh: : 出乎意料，基本不会。

lines.en: : That is surprising. You are large and intimidating.
lines.zh: : 这真让人意外。你又高大又吓人。

lines.en: : Your size is one of the main reasons I was excited for you to see me this morning.
lines.zh: : 你的体格，是我今天早上期待见到你的主要原因之一。

lines.en: : I’m glad that you’re using me for my ability to carry groceries.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你只是看中我搬杂货的能力。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience4
: I would have done it myself but my shoulder-tubes are bad. They don’t move the way they should if I use them too much.
lines.zh: : 我本来想自己干的，可我的肩管不行。用得太多，它们就不听使唤了。

lines.en: : Aren’t you using them all day in the restaurant?
lines.zh: : 你在餐厅里不是整天都在用它们吗？

lines.en: : Just for a few thousand milliseconds at a time. The time is negligible.
lines.zh: : 一次也就用个几千毫秒。时间可以忽略不计。

lines.en: : Why do you know words like “negligible” but not “arms?”
lines.zh: : 为什么你会「忽略不计」这种词，却不会说「胳膊」？

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience5
: The word used does not matter nearly as much as the meaning.
lines.zh: : 用哪个词，远没有它要表达的意思重要。

lines.en: : It’s just like referring to a mother. Everyone has their own word and they all mean the same thing.
lines.zh: : 就像称呼母亲一样。每个人都有自己的叫法，意思全都一样。

lines.en: : Why is it not acceptable to do the same with objects or appendages?
lines.zh: : 那为什么对物件或者附肢，就不能同样这么干呢？

lines.en: : Because those things are a lot less personal than a family member. But I guess it doesn’t really matter.
lines.zh: : 因为那些东西远没有家人那么私人化。不过我想这也无所谓。

lines.en: : It does not. You should know that as my teacher so that you do not charge me for your false instructions.
lines.zh: : 确实无所谓。作为我的老师，你应该明白这一点，这样你就不会为自己那些虚假的教导收我的钱了。

lines.en: : I already told you I’m not going to charge you for helping you with your...language skills. I’m doing this because I want you to succeed in the world.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，帮你提升……语言能力，我不会收钱。我做这些，是因为我想让你在这个世界上好好过下去。

lines.en: : Your words sound kind but your face says you want me to fail.
lines.zh: : 你的话听着很温柔，可你的脸在说你希望我失败。

lines.en: : That’s just how my face looks. I can promise I don’t want you to fail.
lines.zh: : 我的脸本来就长这样。我可以保证，我不希望你在任何事情上失败。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience6
: I appreciate your face. Even if it roots for my demise.
lines.zh: : 我很欣赏你的脸。哪怕它在盼着我完蛋。

lines.en: : Well...Thank you. I think.
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢。我想是吧。

lines.en: : Apology accepted.
lines.zh: : 道歉接受。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience7
: Friend, I have a question for you.
lines.zh: : 朋友，我有个问题想问你。

lines.en: : Do you think that there are things in this world that are not worth fixing?
lines.zh: : 你觉得，这个世界上有没有什么东西是不值得修的？

lines.en: : Like, things that are already broken or-
lines.zh: : 比如，已经坏掉的东西，或者——

lines.en: : Or things that are bound to break.
lines.zh: : 或者迟早会坏的东西。

lines.en: : I feel weak and insignificant forcing someone so special to me to make up for what I lack in tube-strength.
lines.zh: : 逼一个对我这么特别的人来补我在管子力气上的不足，让我觉得自己又弱又渺小。

lines.en: : Again, I’m doing this because I want to.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我做这些是因为我自己想做。

lines.en: : Yes but carrying bags does not make for an exciting date. We should be carrying each other's diaries from our elementary[school] years.
lines.zh: : 是，可是提袋子算不上什么让人兴奋的约会。我们应该互相捧着对方小学[school] 时代的日记才对。

lines.en: : What kind of weird expectation of a date is that?
lines.zh: : 这是对约会的什么奇怪期待啊？

lines.en: : It sounded fun in my head. I would like to see the things young-Friend thought when he was not so filled with anguish and meat.
lines.zh: : 在我脑子里听着挺好玩的。我想看看，在还没有被痛苦和肉填满的时候，年轻的朋友都在想些什么。

lines.en: : Hate to break it to you but I never had a diary. Those are more of a girl thing.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾要让你失望了，我从来没写过日记。那更像是女孩子干的事。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience8
: Then what did you use as a boy to get your feelings out?
lines.zh: : 那你小时候是用什么把情绪抒发出来的？

lines.en: : You were not the type to terrorize small animals or destroy mailboxes, were you?
lines.zh: : 你不是那种会欺负小动物、砸邮箱的人吧？

lines.en: : Uhh, no.
lines.zh: : 呃，不是。

lines.en: : I don’t remember much about my childhood, but I’ve never really done anything to “get my feelings out.”
lines.zh: : 我的童年我记不太清了，不过我从来没真的做过什么「把情绪抒发出来」的事。

lines.en: : Even if I were to express something, I don’t know what it would be.
lines.zh: : 就算我要表达点什么，我也不知道该表达什么。

lines.en: : Do you not feel?
lines.zh: : 你没有感觉吗？

lines.en: : I definitely feel.
lines.zh: : 我当然有感觉。

lines.en: : Just...not as much, I guess?
lines.zh: : 只是……没那么多吧，大概？

lines.en: What’s the use in self-expression anyway?
lines.zh: 说到底，自我表达有什么用呢？

lines.en: Sure, you might get short bursts of self-satisfaction or the chance to reflect on ideas you’ve had in the past-
lines.zh: 当然，你可能会得到短暂爆发的自我满足，或者有机会回味自己过去的想法——

lines.en: But as time goes by, looking back on those things just brings more pain than it does anything else.
lines.zh: 可随着时间推移，回头看这些东西，带来的痛苦往往比别的什么都多。

lines.en: The fact that those fragments of your former self still float around in the ether until you’re unfortunate enough to watch them resurface is just further proof that we should all sit around and sulk until we die.
lines.zh: 你昔日自我的那些碎片，会一直飘在以太里，直到你倒霉地亲眼看着它们重新浮出水面——这件事本身就进一步证明，我们大家就该坐着生闷气，一直到死。

lines.en: Love, me.
lines.zh: 爱你的，我。

lines.en: : Then do you not know happiness?
lines.zh: : 那你是不知道快乐吗？

lines.en: : I know happiness just as much as I know sadness or anger. I just choose not to react to them.
lines.zh: : 我了解快乐，就像我了解悲伤和愤怒一样。我只是选择不对它们做出反应。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience9
: This makes me sad. I will now react, like a normal, non-Friend human.
lines.zh: : 这让我很难过。那我现在就要做出反应，像个正常的、不是朋友的人类那样。

lines.en: : I want to see you smile the way I smile when I return to my living quarters and find John pecking away at a cooked fast food hamburger.
lines.zh: : 我想看到你笑，就像我回到住处、发现 John 正一口口啄着一只做熟的快餐汉堡时，我露出的那种笑。

lines.en: : Didn’t I tell you to stop feeding him h-
lines.zh: : 我不是叫你别再喂他汉——

lines.en: : You told me no such thing.
lines.zh: : 你没说过这种话。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience10
: If you are to not express joy when you are happy or tears when you cry, what am I to do as your friend?
lines.zh: : 如果你开心时不表达喜悦，想哭时也不流泪，那作为你的朋友，我该怎么办？

lines.en: : I have no tears left in my body, but if I were to magically regenerate them and cry like a small human, I would want you to understand my sadness.
lines.zh: : 我身体里已经没有眼泪了，不过要是我能神奇地重新长出眼泪、像个小人儿那样哭出来，我会希望你能懂我的悲伤。

lines.en: : You really don’t have to worry about me. I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 你真的不用担心我。我没事。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience11
: No! It is exactly my job as a friend to worry. I shall not back down because you are afraid of happiness.
lines.zh: : 不！担心本来就是我作为朋友的职责。我不会因为你害怕幸福就退让。

lines.en: : I’m not afraid of happiness...
lines.zh: : 我不怕幸福……

lines.en: : Do you understand my concern, Friend?
lines.zh: : 你明白我的担心吗，朋友？

lines.en: : Not really, but I don’t understand anything you do so I’ve kind of just accepted it at this point.
lines.zh: : 不太明白，不过你做的任何事我都不明白，所以到这一步我也就接受了。

lines.en: : I say these things to you so that you may find peace!
lines.zh: : 我跟你说这些，是为了让你找到内心的平静！

lines.en: : This world is filled with trouble! Horrible things!
lines.zh: : 这个世界充满了麻烦！可怕的事情！

lines.en: : But take heart, Friend. The Queen of Spiders has overcome this world!
lines.zh: : 不过振作起来，朋友。蜘蛛女王已经征服了这个世界！

lines.en: : And if I must overcome it once more to make you smile, I will!
lines.zh: : 如果我必须再征服一次才能让你笑出来，我也会去做的！

lines.en: : Unless overcoming it again means returning John. That is where I draw the line.
lines.zh: : 除非再征服一次意味着要把 John 还回去。那条线我绝对不跨。

lines.en: : Returning your chicken wouldn’t really do anything for me either way, so I wouldn’t worry about that.
lines.zh: : 把你的鸡还回去，对我反正也没什么意义，所以你不用担心这个。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience12
: All this being said, will you now attempt to express your feelings more?
lines.zh: : 话都说到这份上了，你现在愿意试着多表达一点自己的感受吗？

lines.en: : Right now may not be a good time as your hands are clenched around the plastic handles of grocery-receptacles, but if you would like to try dancing I will promise not to laugh.
lines.zh: : 现在可能不太合适，毕竟你的手正攥着那些装杂货的容器的塑料提手，不过如果你想试着跳个舞，我保证不笑你。

lines.en: : Can we talk about something else? I can’t say I’m a fan of being coaxed out of the shell I’ve built around myself.
lines.zh: : 我们能聊点别的吗？我可不怎么喜欢被人哄着从自己筑起的壳里爬出来。

lines.en: : We can talk about other shelled-creatures if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 要是你愿意，我们可以聊聊别的带壳生物。

lines.en: : My personal favorite is the tortoise.
lines.zh: : 我个人最喜欢的是乌龟。

lines.en: : And if I had to choose which animal would represent you in an all-animal reenactment of our relationship, it is the third animal I would choose for the part.
lines.zh: : 要是在一部全动物出演的我俩关系的重现剧里，让我选一种动物来演你，它会是我排第三的选择。

lines.en: : How about something completely unrelated to shelled-creatures?
lines.zh: : 聊点和带壳生物完全无关的东西怎么样？

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Tell me more about yourself.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。多跟我说说你自己吧。

lines.en: : Were you always this...expressive when you were a kid?
lines.zh: : 你小时候……也一直这么……外露吗？

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience13
: You want to hear about Mini-Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你想听迷你 Kaori 的事？

lines.en: : You refer to your childhood self as Mini-Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你把自己的童年叫作迷你 Kaori？

lines.en: : She is the miniature version of me, so yes.
lines.zh: : 她是我的迷你版，所以是的。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience14
: My memories of those days are enshrouded in fog, so this may not be as true as it should be.
lines.zh: : 那些日子的记忆都被雾笼罩着，所以接下来这些可能没那么准确。

lines.en: : But I believe I may have openly felt things not common of people in my age group.
lines.zh: : 但我想，我可能曾经把一些同龄人不太会有的感受，直接表现出来了。

lines.en: : Mini-Kaori had just as many friends as she has now. Only one.
lines.zh: : 迷你 Kaori 的朋友数量，和她现在一样多。只有一个。

lines.en: : But the old friend disappeared when I-
lines.zh: : 可那个老朋友消失了，在我——

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience15
: EEK!
lines.zh: : EEK！

lines.en: Kaori drops her melon bread on the ground the second her phone starts ringing.
lines.zh: 手机一响，Kaori 就把手里的蜜瓜包掉在了地上。

lines.en: : I forgot to align my phone with the moon again after responding to your cries for help!
lines.zh: : 回应完你的求救之后，我又忘了把手机对准月亮了！

lines.en: : The sudden noise startled me! My third cookie bread is ruined!
lines.zh: : 突如其来的声音吓了我一跳！我的第三个曲奇面包报废了！

lines.en: : You should probably answer your phone, at least. It’s probably your work.
lines.zh: : 你至少该接个电话吧。大概是你店里打来的。

lines.en: : We’ve been standing in this parking lot for quite some time now and my arms are starting to get tired anyway.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我们在这个停车场也站了好一会儿了，我的胳膊开始酸了。

lines.en: : R-Right! Telephone!
lines.zh: : 对、对！电话！

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience16
: T-Telephone?
lines.zh: : 电、电话？

lines.en: : Why are you holding it like that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么那样拿着它？

lines.en: : Uh-huh.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : The leeks are safe and secure in plastic containers carried by a large man.
lines.zh: : 大葱很安全，就装在一个大个子男人提着的塑料容器里。

lines.en: : No, I am not in danger.
lines.zh: : 不，我没有遇到危险。

lines.en: : He is my friend and he does not know how to express himself.
lines.zh: : 他是我的朋友，而且他不知道该怎么表达自己。

lines.en: : Was that information really necessary to give out?
lines.zh: : 这个信息非说不可吗？

lines.en: : Yes, I will return shortly.
lines.zh: : 好的，我很快就回去。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience17
: No, I do not see one.
lines.zh: : 不，我没看到。

lines.en: : See what? Now what are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 看到什么？你这又在说什么？

lines.en: : My manager said there was a large sky-football passing over the city.
lines.zh: : 我的店长说，有一个巨大的天上橄榄球正从城市上空飞过。

lines.en: She must be talking about a blimp.
lines.zh: 她说的一定是飞艇吧。

lines.en: : He knows how much I like them so I must remain vigilant in order to see it.
lines.zh: : 他知道我有多喜欢那东西，所以我必须保持警惕，才能看到它。

lines.en: : What kind of person loves-
lines.zh: : 什么样的人会喜欢——

lines.en: : Actually, you’re exactly the kind of person that would love something like that.
lines.zh: : 算了，你就是那种会喜欢这种东西的人。

lines.en: : Heard.
lines.zh: : 收到。

lines.en: : I will return before the sun begins to die.
lines.zh: : 我会在太阳开始死去之前赶回去。

lines.en: : Sayonara.
lines.zh: : Sayonara。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience18
Kaori hangs up her phone and looks at me with a sudden flood of disappointment in her eyes.
lines.zh: Kaori 挂掉电话，看着我，眼里突然涌上一片失望。

lines.en: : I am sorry, Friend, but I must return to work now.
lines.zh: : 对不起，朋友，我现在得回去上班了。

lines.en: : I mean, I still have to carry all of these for you, so you don’t have to say goodbye just yet.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我还得帮你把这些全搬过去，所以你还不用这么快说再见。

lines.en: : Oh. That is correct.
lines.zh: : 哦。你说得对。

lines.en: : If I took them from you, they would end up as dinner for the cement. And cement does not eat so this would benefit no one.
lines.zh: : 如果我从你手里接过来，它们最后会变成水泥的晚餐。而水泥又不吃东西，这样对谁都没好处。

lines.en: : I’m glad we’re on the same page.
lines.zh: : 很高兴我们想法一致。

lines.en: scene kaoriconvenience19
: Thank you again for your assistance.
lines.zh: : 再次感谢你的帮助。

lines.en: : I promise to return the favor in the future once my arms return to their full strength and you suddenly begin to wither away into dust.
lines.zh: : 我保证，等将来我的胳膊恢复全部力气、而你突然开始衰弱成尘埃的那天，我一定会报答你。

lines.en: : I will keep that in mind...
lines.zh: : 我会记在心里的……

lines.en: scene black
The two of us continue our walk back to the diner and, within less than twenty minutes, we’re there.
lines.zh: 我俩继续往那家小餐馆走，不到二十分钟就到了。

lines.en: Kaori and I part ways-
lines.zh: Kaori 和我就此分别——

lines.en: But not before she remembers to pay me in roughly seven high-fives that she apparently believes are an actual form of human currency.
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，她没忘记付我报酬——大概七次击掌，她显然认为那是人类真实流通的货币。

lines.en: $ kaori_love += 1
$ kaoridate10 = True
Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!
lines.zh: Kaori 的好感度提升到了 [kaori_love]!
